;
        org     #8000
;
        defmac  MOVE
        ld      hl,/0
        ld      de,/1
        ld      bc,/2
        ldir
        endmac
;
        defmac  hl*8
;
        add     hl,hl
        add     hl,hl
        add     hl,hl
        jp      ...1
...1
;
        endmac
;
        defmac  hl*16
        add     hl,hl
        add     hl,hl
        add     hl,hl
        add     hl,hl
        jr      ...1
...1
        endmac
;
        .LOCAL
        ld      b,0
...1
        dec     b
        jp      nz,...1
;
        ld      hl,10
        hl*8
        display ...1
        .LOCAL
        ld      c,0
...1
        dec     c
        jp      nz,...1
;
        ld      hl,4
        hl*16
        display ...1
        ld      hl,0
        hl*8
        display ...1
        MOVE    0,16384,6144
        ret
